effective_date_basis: Effective date of the revoking or disposing instrument, or a current basis.
ending_pattern: Continues until revoked, transferred or disposed of (often under surplus property acts). Diminutions restore part of the lands; transfers to another department change jurisdiction rather than end the reservation.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Transfers and disposals carry valid existing rights.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
Reservations in the Philippines or Canal Zone (also mapped to X1-E3 or X1-E4).
The order keeps reversions, water rights or rights-of-way (the exemplar, paras 2-3): these residual interests outlive the restoration and need their own state.
Territorial lands (Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico) subject to admission or organic acts; for Hawaii the Admission Act of 1959 s.5 is a lead on lands set aside for federal use, not an assumed end.
Disposal under the Surplus Property Act of 1944 or the Federal Property and Administrative Services Act of 1949: the deed date is the end.
